steps.eval: (async () => { while (!(window.T && T.ready)) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); window.settle = async () => { while (T.stage.k < 1) await T.wait(30); await T.wait(300); }; window.scoopTo = async (id, cell) => { const bi = T.wall.bins.findIndex((b) => b.def.id === id); const b = T.wall.bins[bi]; if (T.game.bin !== b) { T.focus(bi); await settle(); await T.wait(900); } const [x, y] = T.screen(b.mouth); T.ptr('pointerdown', x, y); await T.wait(300); while (T.scoop.state === 'dig') await T.wait(40); await settle(); const c = T.tray.cells[cell]; const v = T.L.tray.clone().set(c.x, T.tray.home.y + T.tray.depth, c.z).applyMatrix4(T.tray.matrix); const [tx, ty] = T.screen(v); for (let k = 1; k <= 10; k++) { T.ptr('pointermove', x + ((tx - x) * k) / 10, y + ((ty - y) * k) / 10); await T.wait(30); } await T.wait(500); return [tx, ty]; }; for (const [id, cell] of [['jawbreaker', 0], ['jelly-bean', 2], ['liquid-gem', 3], ['choc-lentil', 4], ['sour-belt', 5], ['gummy-worm', 6], ['giant-strawberry', 7], ['peach-ring', 8]]) { const [x, y] = await scoopTo(id, cell); T.ptr('pointerup', x, y); while (T.scoop.state === 'pour') await T.wait(40); await T.wait(1500); } window.last = await scoopTo('gummy-bear', 1); await T.wait(600); })()

note: Needs the test hooks, so load the page with ?test=1. Scripted through window.T: eight scoops poured into the flower tray (jawbreakers, jelly beans, liquid gems, chocolate lentils, sour belts, gummy worms, giant strawberries, peach rings), then a scoop of gummy bears held over the last empty compartment. Needs a GPU browser, so the published frame was rendered with Candy Wall/Niepotrzebne/tools/shot.mjs and tools/hero.js (ANGLE Metal, 1200x900 at 2x, local build) and applied with shot.mjs set.
